resources.string: Local cryptographic check of CMS/CAdES and PDF/PAdES. Checks integrity and binding to the included certificate, not identity, certificate trust or validity. Revocation not checked (no OCSP/CRL). Dates are claimed; timestamps are not validated. XML/XAdES is unsupported.

Local files only: PDF up to 2 MiB, CMS up to 1 MiB, original up to 512 KiB. The optional original is only for detached CMS; remove it for PDF. Up to 8 PDF signatures; RSA Adobe/ETSI approval profiles. Other profiles or encrypted documents are rejected.
Limit exceeded: PDF 2 MiB, CMS 1 MiB, original 512 KiB. Integrity not checked.
Unsupported format or profile. Integrity not checked.
Integrity not checked: invalid signature, changed content, incorrect original or unsupported profile. For PDF or CMS with included content, remove the optional original.
No signatures found in this PDF.
Signed revision integrity checked; trust and revocation not checked.
Unsigned changes or bytes follow the last signature. Integrity of the current PDF has not been established.
Later revisions or bytes follow this signature; it covers only its signed revision.
